description: This file defines the ConceptInUseException class, a custom exception used within the OpenMRS API to indicate issues related to concepts that are currently in use or attached to an observation.

classes.name: ConceptInUseException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending APIException, thrown when a concept is in use or attached to an observation.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating concepts cannot be changed when in use.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message for the exception.

methods.name: ConceptInUseException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message and a cause (parent exception).

methods.name: ConceptInUseException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a cause, without a custom message.
